first-idea.name: Le manatu muamua
first-idea.line: O le talanoaga sili ona muamua, aʻo leʻi iai se code.
first-board.name: Le laupapa muamua
first-board.line: O se laupapa e mulimuli i lona lava fausiaga: kāte, koluma, toso ma tuu, poloketi.
team-roles.name: ʻAu ma tofiga
team-roles.line: Faamatalaga o sui, faʻataʻitaʻiga o ʻau, avanoa ma o ai e faia le a.
install.name: Faapipiʻiga ma lomiga
install.line: O se zip e mafai e se uo ona faapipii, faafouga otometi, auala ma toe foʻi.
usage-saver.name: Faasaoina o le faaaogaina
usage-saver.line: Fuaina le tau o le faatinoga, tausia le code e vaivai, faasaoina lau tapulaa.
friends.name: Uo ma le faasoaina
friends.line: Feʻau tuusao, se relay faalilolilo, valaaulia, tofiga ma poloketi faasoa.
languages.name: Gagana
languages.line: O tusitusiga uma o le mataʻitusi i se faila gagana, ma le Holani ma le Flemish muamua.
ai-tester.name: AI suʻesuʻe
ai-tester.line: E muamua siaki e se suʻesuʻe tuuina atu uma ma faaali le mea na ia vaai i ai.
website.name: Le initaneti
website.line: aigile.lol, le teaser ma lenei taimi.
streaming.name: Talanoaga ma faasalalauga
streaming.line: Discord, Twitch, OBS, auala faasalalau, GIF ma emoji.
no-ai.name: Lomiga e leai se AI
no-ai.line: O se laupapa mo tagata e tusi polokalama e aunoa ma AI, ma laupapa lautele.
night-watch.name: Leoleo po
night-watch.line: O se leoleo ma se Scrum Master e tausia ʻau i galuega a e moe oe.
p-more.name: Isi mea uma
p-more.line: Manatu laiti o loo faatali pea i le latou taimi.
p-android.name: Telefoni ma Android
p-android.line: Oo atu i lau laupapa mai se telefoni, ona sosoo ai lea ma se polokalama Android.
p-release.name: Alpha ma mulimuli ane
p-release.line: Alpha tapunia, le initaneti ola, ona sosoo ai lea ma le beta.
p-languages.name: Sili atu gagana
p-languages.line: E 130 gagana, ma se auala faʻalauteleina o le gagana mo i latou o aʻoaʻo.
p-engines.name: Sili atu afi AI
p-engines.line: Filifili Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot po o Cursor mo sooupu taʻitasi.
p-pro.name: Faiga faapolofesa
p-pro.line: Faailoga o lamatiaga, faitotoʻa tuufaatasia, kāte o mea e tutupu ma puipuiga.
p-self.name: Tausia oe
p-self.line: Auala o le vaivai, faamanatu o le tausiga o oe lava ma le 4:20.
p-servers.name: Server ma le tuputupu aʻe
p-servers.line: Setiina lautele o server, tofiga ma fuafuaga mo le tuputupu aʻe.
p-livestream.name: Faaopoopoga faasalalau
p-livestream.line: Talanoaga Twitch, emoji faapitoa ma se vaaiga ola lautele.
